mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 84 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park, an air quality index of 54, and a beautiful full moon tonight. The overnight low will be 62 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest for students, and online voting for the four winning categories is now open through August 7. Paper ballots are also available at City Hall during absentee voting hours for the upcoming primary.

We have a busy couple of days ahead with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia fun.
In police news, a 55 year old driver was arrested for an O W I after being stopped for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway last Sunday, July 26.

Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, so stop by Culver's before they close at 10 PM. You can also visit the Kona Ice truck today at Fireman's Park until 4:15 PM or at Connors Field until 6:30 PM.
